name: x2611_14198_thm1_1_maximal
statement: (d p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hd : 3 ≤ d) (hodd : Odd d) (hcop : ¬ p ∣ 2 * d) (hp : p % 4 = 1) : (∃ r : ℕ, 1 ≤ r ∧ x2611_14198_maximal d p r) ↔ (∃ (ℓ n : ℕ), ℓ.Prime ∧ ℓ % 4 = 1 ∧ 1 ≤ n ∧ d = ℓ ^ n ∧ IsPrimitiveRoot (p : ZMod (ℓ ^ n)) (Nat.totient (ℓ ^ n)))
closed: ∀ (d p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hd : 3 ≤ d) (hodd : Odd d) (hcop : ¬ p ∣ 2 * d) (hp : p % 4 = 1), (∃ r : ℕ, 1 ≤ r ∧ x2611_14198_maximal d p r) ↔ (∃ (ℓ n : ℕ), ℓ.Prime ∧ ℓ % 4 = 1 ∧ 1 ≤ n ∧ d = ℓ ^ n ∧ IsPrimitiveRoot (p : ZMod (ℓ ^ n)) (Nat.totient (ℓ ^ n)))
original:
Let $d\geq 3$ be odd and let $p\nmid 2d$ be a prime with
 $p\equiv 1\pmod{4}$ . The following conditions are equivalent:

(1) 

 $\operatorname{Jac}(\mathcal{H}_{d})$ is supersingular;

(2) 

 $\mathcal{H}_{d}$ is maximal over some finite extension of $\mathbb{F}_{p}$ ;

(3) 

 $d=\ell^{n}$ for a prime $\ell\equiv 1\pmod{4}$ and an integer
 $n\geq 1$ , and $p$ generates $(\mathbb{Z}/\ell^{n}\mathbb{Z})^{\times}$ .
type: ∀ (d p : ℕ) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)], 3 ≤ d → Odd d → ¬p ∣ 2 * d → p % 4 = 1 → ((∃ r, 1 ≤ r ∧ Mathlib2.x2611_14198_maximal d p r) ↔ ∃ ℓ n, Nat.Prime ℓ ∧ ℓ % 4 = 1 ∧ 1 ≤ n ∧ d = ℓ ^ n ∧ IsPrimitiveRoot (↑p) (ℓ ^ n).totient)

open scoped BigOperators

lemma x2611_14198_thm1_1_maximal_aux1 (d a : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (h : IsPrimitiveRoot (a : ZMod d) d.totient) : IsCyclic (ZMod d)ˣ := by
  letI : NeZero d := ⟨hd.ne'⟩
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := h.isUnit (Nat.totient_pos.mpr hd).ne'
  apply isCyclic_of_orderOf_eq_card u
  rw [← orderOf_units, hu, ← h.eq_orderOf, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card,
    ZMod.card_units_eq_totient]

lemma x2611_14198_thm1_1_maximal_aux2 (ℓ n : ℕ) (hℓ : ℓ.Prime)
    (hodd : Odd ℓ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    4 ∣ (ℓ ^ n).totient ↔ ℓ % 4 = 1 := by
  rw [Nat.totient_prime_pow hℓ hn]
  have hc : Nat.Coprime 4 (ℓ ^ (n - 1)) := by
    simpa using ((hodd.pow : Odd (ℓ ^ (n - 1))).coprime_two_left.pow_left 2)
  rw [hc.dvd_mul_left]
  have hl := hℓ.two_le
  omega

lemma x2611_14198_thm1_1_maximal_aux3 (d a : ℕ) (hd : 3 ≤ d) (hodd : Odd d) :
    (∃ (ℓ n : ℕ), ℓ.Prime ∧ ℓ % 4 = 1 ∧ 1 ≤ n ∧ d = ℓ ^ n ∧
      IsPrimitiveRoot (a : ZMod (ℓ ^ n)) (ℓ ^ n).totient) ↔
    (IsPrimitiveRoot (a : ZMod d) d.totient ∧ 4 ∣ d.totient) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ℓ, n, hℓ, hmod, hn, rfl, hroot⟩
    refine ⟨hroot, (x2611_14198_thm1_1_maximal_aux2 ℓ n hℓ ?_ hn).mpr hmod⟩
    exact Nat.odd_iff.mpr (by omega)
  · rintro ⟨hroot, hfour⟩
    have hc := x2611_14198_thm1_1_maximal_aux1 d a (by omega) hroot
    obtain ⟨ℓ, n, hℓ, hoddℓ, heq⟩ := (ZMod.isCyclic_units_iff_of_odd hodd).mp hc
    have hn : 1 ≤ n := by
      by_contra h
      have hn0 : n = 0 := by omega
      simp [hn0] at heq
      omega
    subst d
    exact ⟨ℓ, n, hℓ,
      (x2611_14198_thm1_1_maximal_aux2 ℓ n hℓ hoddℓ hn).mp hfour,
      hn, rfl, hroot⟩

lemma x2611_14198_thm1_1_maximal_aux4 (ℓ n : ℕ) (hℓ : 1 ≤ ℓ) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, ℓ ^ (j - 1) * (ℓ - 1)) + 1 = ℓ ^ n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega)]
    simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    calc
      _ = ((∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, ℓ ^ (j - 1) * (ℓ - 1)) + 1) +
          ℓ ^ n * (ℓ - 1) := by omega
      _ = ℓ ^ n * (ℓ - 1 + 1) := by rw [ih]; ring
      _ = ℓ ^ (n + 1) := by rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hℓ, pow_succ]

lemma x2611_14198_thm1_1_maximal_aux5 (ℓ n j : ℕ) (hj : 1 ≤ j) (hjn : j ≤ n) :
    ℓ ^ (n - 1) * (ℓ - 1) = (ℓ ^ (j - 1) * (ℓ - 1)) * ℓ ^ (n - j) := by
  calc
    _ = ℓ ^ ((j - 1) + (n - j)) * (ℓ - 1) := by congr 2; omega
    _ = _ := by rw [pow_add]; ring

lemma x2611_14198_thm1_1_maximal_aux6 (p r : ℕ) (hr : Even r) :
    Real.sqrt ((p : ℝ) ^ r) = (p : ℝ) ^ (r / 2) := by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hr
  have hk : k + k = k * 2 := by omega
  rw [hk, Nat.mul_div_cancel k (by decide), pow_mul, Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)]

lemma x2611_14198_thm1_1_maximal_aux7 (ℓ n : ℕ) (hℓ : 1 < ℓ) (hodd : Odd ℓ) :
    (∑ j ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 n).filter
      (fun j => ℓ ^ (j - 1) * (ℓ - 1) ∣ ℓ ^ (n - 1) * (ℓ - 1)),
      ((ℓ ^ (j - 1) * (ℓ - 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) *
        (-1 : ℤ) ^ ((ℓ ^ (n - 1) * (ℓ - 1)) / (ℓ ^ (j - 1) * (ℓ - 1)))) =
      -((ℓ ^ n - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
  have hf : (Finset.Icc 1 n).filter
      (fun j => ℓ ^ (j - 1) * (ℓ - 1) ∣ ℓ ^ (n - 1) * (ℓ - 1)) =
      Finset.Icc 1 n := by
    apply Finset.filter_eq_self.mpr
    intro j hj
    obtain ⟨hj, hjn⟩ := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hj
    exact ⟨ℓ ^ (n - j), x2611_14198_thm1_1_maximal_aux5 ℓ n j hj hjn⟩
  rw [hf]
  calc
    _ = ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, -((ℓ ^ (j - 1) * (ℓ - 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      obtain ⟨hj, hjn⟩ := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hj
      have hm : 0 < ℓ ^ (j - 1) * (ℓ - 1) :=
        Nat.mul_pos (pow_pos (by omega : 0 < ℓ) _) (by omega)
      rw [x2611_14198_thm1_1_maximal_aux5 ℓ n j hj hjn,
        Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hm,
        (hodd.pow : Odd (ℓ ^ (n - j))).neg_one_pow, mul_neg_one]
    _ = -((∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, ℓ ^ (j - 1) * (ℓ - 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_neg_distrib, Nat.cast_sum]
    _ = _ := by
      congr 1
      have h := x2611_14198_thm1_1_maximal_aux4 ℓ n (by omega)
      congr 1
      omega

lemma x2611_14198_thm1_1_maximal_aux8 (ℓ p n : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] [Fact p.Prime]
    (hℓ : ℓ % 4 = 1) (hp : p % 4 = 1) (hne : ℓ ≠ p) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hgen : IsPrimitiveRoot (p : ZMod (ℓ ^ n)) (Nat.totient (ℓ ^ n)))
    (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) :
    (x2611_14198_point_count (ℓ ^ n) p r : ℤ) = (p : ℤ) ^ r + 1 -
      ∑ j ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 n).filter (fun j => ℓ ^ (j - 1) * (ℓ - 1) ∣ r),
        ((ℓ ^ (j - 1) * (ℓ - 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) *
          (-1 : ℤ) ^ (r / (ℓ ^ (j - 1) * (ℓ - 1))) * (p : ℤ) ^ (r / 2) := by
  sorry

lemma x2611_14198_thm1_1_maximal_aux9 (ℓ p n : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] [Fact p.Prime]
    (hℓ : ℓ % 4 = 1) (hp : p % 4 = 1) (hne : ℓ ≠ p) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hgen : IsPrimitiveRoot (p : ZMod (ℓ ^ n)) (Nat.totient (ℓ ^ n))) :
    ∃ r : ℕ, 1 ≤ r ∧ x2611_14198_maximal (ℓ ^ n) p r := by
  have hprime : ℓ.Prime := Fact.out
  have hl : 1 < ℓ := hprime.one_lt
  have hodd : Odd ℓ := Nat.odd_iff.mpr (by omega)
  let r := ℓ ^ (n - 1) * (ℓ - 1)
  have hr : 1 ≤ r := by
    change 0 < ℓ ^ (n - 1) * (ℓ - 1)
    exact Nat.mul_pos (pow_pos (by omega : 0 < ℓ) _) (by omega)
  refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
  have hc := x2611_14198_thm1_1_maximal_aux8 ℓ p n hℓ hp hne hn hgen r hr
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul] at hc
  have hsum := x2611_14198_thm1_1_maximal_aux7 ℓ n hl hodd
  change (∑ j ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 n).filter (fun j => ℓ ^ (j - 1) * (ℓ - 1) ∣ r),
      ((ℓ ^ (j - 1) * (ℓ - 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) *
        (-1 : ℤ) ^ (r / (ℓ ^ (j - 1) * (ℓ - 1)))) =
      -((ℓ ^ n - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) at hsum
  rw [hsum, neg_mul, sub_neg_eq_add] at hc
  have hcR : (x2611_14198_point_count (ℓ ^ n) p r : ℝ) =
      (p : ℝ) ^ r + 1 + ((ℓ ^ n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (p : ℝ) ^ (r / 2) := by
    exact_mod_cast hc
  have hr4 : 4 ∣ r := by
    change 4 ∣ ℓ ^ (n - 1) * (ℓ - 1)
    rw [← Nat.totient_prime_pow hprime (by omega : 0 < n)]
    exact (x2611_14198_thm1_1_maximal_aux2 ℓ n hprime hodd (by omega)).mpr hℓ
  have hrEven : Even r := even_iff_two_dvd.mpr (dvd_trans (by decide : 2 ∣ 4) hr4)
  have hoddD : (ℓ ^ n) % 2 = 1 := Nat.odd_iff.mp (hodd.pow : Odd (ℓ ^ n))
  have hg : 2 * ((ℓ ^ n - 1) / 2) = ℓ ^ n - 1 := by omega
  have hgR : (2 : ℝ) * (((ℓ ^ n - 1) / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) = ((ℓ ^ n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hg
  unfold x2611_14198_maximal
  rw [hcR, x2611_14198_thm1_1_maximal_aux6 p r hrEven, hgR]

theorem x2611_14198_thm1_1_maximal (d p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hd : 3 ≤ d)
    (hodd : Odd d) (hcop : ¬ p ∣ 2 * d) (hp : p % 4 = 1) :
    (∃ r : ℕ, 1 ≤ r ∧ x2611_14198_maximal d p r) ↔
    (∃ (ℓ n : ℕ), ℓ.Prime ∧ ℓ % 4 = 1 ∧ 1 ≤ n ∧ d = ℓ ^ n ∧
      IsPrimitiveRoot (p : ZMod (ℓ ^ n)) (Nat.totient (ℓ ^ n))) := by
  have hnecessity : (∃ r : ℕ, 1 ≤ r ∧ x2611_14198_maximal d p r) →
      (IsPrimitiveRoot (p : ZMod d) d.totient ∧ 4 ∣ d.totient) := by
    sorry
  constructor
  · intro hm
    exact (x2611_14198_thm1_1_maximal_aux3 d p hd hodd).mpr (hnecessity hm)
  · rintro ⟨ℓ, n, hprime, hℓ, hn, rfl, hgen⟩
    letI : Fact ℓ.Prime := ⟨hprime⟩
    have hne : ℓ ≠ p := by
      intro heq
      subst ℓ
      exact hcop (dvd_mul_of_dvd_right (dvd_pow_self p (by omega)) 2)
    exact x2611_14198_thm1_1_maximal_aux9 ℓ p n hℓ hp hne hn hgen
